description: Hao Chang and Luigi Vanfretti publish a tutorial and companion files for importing OpenIPSL power-system models into DIgSILENT PowerFactory. Zenodo archives version 0.1.2 under BSD 3-Clause and links source, precompiled FMUs, project files and visual instructions. The README documents controller-only FMI coupling for an exciter and a full machine-and-controls FMU, with PowerFactory’s RMS solver advancing the imported states. These examples can test co-simulation integration or controller changes in electricity-network models. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Modelica-to-PowerFactory workflow. Coverage is the specified reference machines and import patterns, not every grid component or PowerFactory release. A limitation is that PowerFactory is a separate commercial dependency and the conference paper was described as submitted. Benchmarks against a native reference are provider claims. No FMU, Modelica source or PowerFactory project was downloaded or executed.
